tests.name: fast lane runs format, analyze and the full test suite
fast lane runs on pull requests to main without privileged triggers

criteria.requirement: Results are deterministic and reproducible; failures are explicit and actionable

tests.name: ac2 fail-closed CI gate fixtures are reproducible

criteria.requirement: No secrets, personal data or raw screenshots in logs/artifacts; no unapproved network egress
criteria.reason: Workflow review is required for artifact/log policy and network egress. test/pr_fast_ci_lane_test.dart only checks read-only permissions, no secrets references and SHA-pinned actions in the workflow file.

criteria.requirement: Backwards compatibility and cross-platform behavior reviewed; no unsupported capability falsely advertised
criteria.reason: This lane intentionally targets Ubuntu-only checks; cross-platform behavior requires platform review.
